slides.texte_overlay:
5 small habits that can improve
your mental health

morning light

step outside within half an hour of waking and let daylight hit your face for ten minutes. it sets your body clock, lifts your mood and helps you sleep better tonight.

a tidy corner

keep one small corner of your room perfectly tidy, even on bad days. a calm space to rest your eyes on gives a busy, tired mind somewhere quiet to land.

a little learning

spend 5 minutes a day learning something calm and new: a constellation, a painting, a myth. gentle curiosity gives your mind something to hold that isn't worry.
slides.texte_sophia:
a little learning

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something calm and new: a constellation, a painting, a myth. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and it gives my mind something besides worry.

slides.texte_overlay:
one honest text

send one honest message a day to someone you trust, even just a short how are you. small real connections protect your mental health more than you'd think.

a screen curfew

stop all screens thirty minutes before bed and read or stretch instead. a quieter last half hour makes falling asleep easier and the next morning lighter.
